review_candidates.title: Information Technology Engineer
matched_queries: Middle East and Africa IT support
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Summary The IT Engineer is responsible for providing technical support and maintaining IT infrastructure, systems, networks, and end-user devices at construction project sites. The IT Engineer coordinates with Head Office IT, project teams, internet service providers, and external vendors to resolve technical issues and ensure compliance with company IT policies, cybersecurity standards, and operational requirements. Key Responsibilities Provide first- and second-level IT support to project
eligibility_evidence: Perform site visits and provide on-site technical support as required by project operational needs.
Saudi national preferred/required , subject to the company's Saudization requirements and approved recruitment criteria.
Experience supporting construction site offices, project teams, consultants, and subcontractors is highly desirable.
Willingness to work on construction sites and support operational requirements as needed.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The IT Engineer coordinates with Head Office IT, project teams, internet service providers, and external vendors to resolve technical issues and ensure compliance with company IT policies, cybersecurity standards, and operational requirements. Manage IT support tickets, prioritize requests according to operational requirements, and maintain accurate records of incidents and resolutions. Ensure compliance with company IT policies, information security requirements, data protection procedures, and applicable regulatory standards. Support IT equipment procurement by providing technical specifications, assessing requirements, and coordinating installation and configuration. Coordinate IT requirements for new project offices, site mobilization, employee deployment, and project demobilization. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science,
